title: A candidate plaintext must survive encode/decode roundtrip on a held construction
summary: Infer a candidate semantic representation from several complete constructions, then regenerate their observable relation pattern and decode a held construction without changing the key.

design.mechanism: roundtrip-stable semantic representation versus overfit local renderer
design.unit: held complete constructions or paired reading contexts
design.contrast: The same finite representation should regenerate both source-side relation constraints and held target constraints; an overfit renderer reproduces training contexts but fails the held construction.
design.prediction: Existing decoders and renderers optimize surface reconstruction or German fluency, not a predeclared semantic roundtrip with a held construction.
design.countermodel: A surface-copying, renderer, or context-conditioned convention can mimic training observations without the proposed semantic mechanism.
design.falsifier: Training passes but the held construction requires a new slot or ad hoc exception, so the candidate is discarded.
design.principal_risk: A representation can be structurally adequate without being linguistic; no solved words are required but an independent relation target is.
design.smallest_test: Define a three-slot abstract semantic representation and hold one complete construction; require exact preservation of participant/order/state constraints.
design.prior_duplicate_pointers: Near GDT581/GDT832 and IDEA000097; distinct criterion is held semantic roundtrip, not raw adjacency or renderer fit.
design.selection_status: raw unreviewed; no readiness or novelty claim
